theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ L < n → MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable n M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ∧ L ≤ Q) → (∀ᵐ t ∂(μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L].restrict (L : Set (Euclid P))), CountablyRectifiable (n - Module.finrank ℝ L) (M ∩ {x | L.starProjection x = t}) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n - Module.finrank ℝ L].restrict (M ∩ {x | L.starProjection x = t})), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (n - Module.finrank ℝ L) (M ∩ {x | L.starProjection x = t}) x (Q ⊓ Lᗮ)) ∧ ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ {x | L.starProjection x = t}, g x ∂μHE[n - Module.finrank ℝ L]) (μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L].restrict (L : Set (Euclid P))) ∧ ∫⁻ x in M, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ t in (L : Set (Euclid P)), ∫⁻ x in M ∩ {x | L.starProjection x = t}, g x ∂μHE[n - Module.finrank ℝ L] ∂μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L]
